prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Make ONE targeted revision of the first supplied portrait, retaining PELAN, a self-possessed working woman ABOUT FIFTY, her dark-brown practical bun, identifiable nose/face, gray-brown garment and stiff pale taupe collar. Image 1 is the edit target; image 2 is the older stylized identity only; remaining images are approved pixel-style anchors, not subjects to copy. Current card age and gray-brown clothes take priority over the old younger green outfit.
Required changes:
1. Replace worried knitted brows with MOSTLY HORIZONTAL, SLIGHTLY LOWERED STRAIGHT BROWS. Especially lower and relax the inner brow ends. Her gaze is level, steady, deliberate, self-possessed, not worried or angry. Replace the downturned mouth with a FIRM LEVEL CLOSED MOUTH, subtly compressed on one side, no smile, no helpless sorrow. She calmly insists on her own terms.
2. Preserve age about fifty using mature slightly heavy eyelids, one broad under-eye shadow plane and broad nasolabial planes. Not many tiny wrinkle lines. Keep female adult anatomy, not a teenager or a frail old crone.
3. Dim the conspicuous eye whites to LOW-LUMINANCE DARK TAUPE/OCHRE-GRAY narrow slivers only 1-2 logical pixels on a 74x100 grid, nearly cheek-shadow brightness. No white, cream bars or bright catchlights.
4. Simplify hair to FOUR TO SIX LARGE CONNECTED DARK BROWN LOCKS. Remove thin parallel strands and wispy disconnected temple curls. Restrain the side hair and compact bun horizontally enough to give at least THREE logical pixels TRANSPARENT SAFETY MARGIN on EACH SIDE, while keeping the face the same large size. Whole bun and ear outlines stay visible. A single broad muted gray temple streak is sufficient, no fine streaks.
Keep extremely tight HEAD framing: face dominates, very short neck, narrow gray-brown garment and starched pale taupe collar at bottom; no green garment, chest, shoulders, jewelry, props, papers or tokens. Keep original warm skin with strong nose wings and mature cheek planes. Broad 2-8 logical pixel clusters on a 74x100 grid, crisp staircase edges, no soft gradients, blur, dithering, speckle, fine texture, antialiasing, text or decorative frame. At most 32 matte earthy colors. True transparent background. Style should read as a deliberately designed low-resolution pixel portrait, never a painterly filter.
